Frog One's bistro pâté.d: Chicken livers seared pink and flamed with cognac, blended with soft butter, shallot and thyme, sealed under clarified butter. Cornichons and warm baguette.

Stakeout coffee and doughnuts.d: Drip, black, in a paper cup. Two warm rings rolled in cinnamon sugar.

Charnier's steak frites.d: Sirloin seared hard and rested. Warm tarragon and shallot butter sauce, hand-cut potatoes fried twice.

Crème caramel.d: Vanilla custard baked slow in a water bath, chilled overnight and turned out under its own amber syrup.

Marseille mauresque.d: Pastis and almond orgeat over ice, iced water poured in at the table until it clouds.
